id: title:haacked:skip backfill rows whose fork row can still be in kafka

review.posthog_relevance: Backfill DAG configuration and flag evaluation reliability
review.reason: Adds Kafka delivery timeout and consumer lag cutoff to prevent double-copying of late flag evaluation rows. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H6 establish the timeout and shard stopping behavior; P1.F1.H7 calculates the cutoff time. This targets the Backfill DAG configuration, improving reliability by preventing processing of stale or late flag evaluation rows.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a bounded correctness improvement. The actual runtime benefit and whether this prevents production incidents are not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier assignment is performed.
